openQuestions: Representative current facade, balcony, podium/open-space and roof samples for Albufereta, Cabo apartment enclaves and Playa de San Juan remain insufficiently evidenced by authoritative building-level sources.

Virgen del Remedio now has one well-documented 1965 rehabilitation subset, but the exact distribution of that subtype versus other block types across the district still needs building-level survey or current visual classification.
Ciudad Elegida Juan XXIII has strong comb/topographic site evidence, but exact current storeys, facade rhythm/materials and roof families across its 16 blocks remain unresolved.
Nueva Albufereta and PAU 5 Sector 2 remain transition/planning contexts; current physical completion should be rechecked against current orthophoto/site evidence immediately before production freeze.
Fine facade/roof/material evidence for Santa Cruz/Raval historic housing and for Vistahermosa/Cabo villa fabrics remains weaker than their spatial-morphology evidence.

Nueva Tabarca now has a defensible traditional-house typology split, but representative roof materials, storey counts and facade palettes require a building-level protected-inventory or current visual survey.
Exact district/zone polygons remain research approximations rather than authoritative GIS extracts; the catalog should not be used as legal/planning geometry.
Benalúa/Babel and rail/Parque Central transition parcels still warrant a current built-state check before production use.
Castillo de Santa Bárbara western-wall restoration began/was agreed in October 2026; the post-restoration appearance is not yet a current-state authority.
